74fe8ed16b3da387:
A meticulously maintained cottage with breathtaking views and extensive grounds

Are you looking for a place that combines an authentic mountain atmosphere with the comforts of year-round living? We are offering an exceptional property with a registered address in the picturesque village of Hranice, just above Rokytnice nad Jizerou, within the Krkonoše National Park (KRNAP). This spacious cottage, with a usable area of approx. 250 m² plus a 50 m² wooden terrace, is situated in a beautiful, sunny spot with breathtaking views of the valley and the Krkonoše countryside.
The property is brick-built and in excellent structural condition. From the wooden terrace, you can enjoy magnificent views all year round, including romantic sunsets. High-quality wooden floors and ceilings, bespoke solid-wood furniture and a stylish stove lend the interior a distinctive style whilst ensuring a long lifespan and minimal maintenance requirements. The cottage is fully habitable all year round, ideal for family holidays as well as for permanent residence or a tourism business. The cottage has never been let out and has been used solely for family holidays.
Key advantages:
•  A plot of over 6,500 m² – offering complete privacy
•  High-quality construction and interior – brick-built with solid timber interiors
•  Access via a local road
•	Panoramic views of the valley
•  Excellent location – close to the ski resorts in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, hiking trails, cross-country ski trails, cycle paths, as well as restaurants and shops
The cottage offers plenty of space, not only in the living area – which features a large living room with a kitchenette and a wood-burning stove, and three large bedrooms on the second floor (see indicative floor plans) – but also in the utility area –  where you’ll find two garages, a stone-built pantry, and a utility room with an electric boiler, washing machine and hot-water tank. The property is fitted with a security system and connected to a central security control centre.
Rokytnice nad Jizerou is one of the largest and most popular mountain resorts in the Krkonoše Mountains. In winter, it offers excellent skiing conditions – the Rokytnice Ski Resort features more than 18 km of downhill runs of all levels of difficulty.
Cross-country skiing enthusiasts will appreciate the groomed trails linked to the Krkonoše Cross-Country Ski Trail; in summer, the area is ideal for cycling or hill walking.
The town offers a full range of amenities – shops, restaurants, cafés, ski and cycle hire shops, schools, a health centre and cultural events throughout the year.
If you’re interested, I can send you a link to an online tour (Matterport).
Please do not hesitate to contact me; I would be delighted to show you around this wonderful property.

421ce8fa80e949b2:
Modern detached house for sale, featuring state-of-the-art technology and an energy efficiency rating of A

We are exclusively offering for sale a new, modern detached house in the peaceful residential area of Zdiměřice near Prague, with a 6+kk layout. The house was designed by Mr Ing.arch.Jiří Záhořák and offers the very best of modern functionalist architecture – a well-thought-out layout, a pleasant connection between the interior and the garden and terrace, plenty of light thanks to generous French windows, and a spacious gallery linking both floors.
The interior is functionally designed to offer ample storage space and comfort, whilst avoiding any wasted space. The wooden floors (to be laid) and exposed concrete ceilings ensure a timeless design and allow everyone to furnish the house according to their own tastes. The house features a spacious living area with a kitchenette opening onto the garden, five further rooms, two of which on the ground floor have their own en-suite bathrooms (a total of 3 bathrooms and 2 separate toilets), and a spacious, light-filled gallery ideal as a study, library or hobby room.
The building’s technical systems have been selected with a focus on ensuring the comfort of its occupants, sustainability and low long-term running costs. The house is designed to cope with future climate challenges. Noteworthy features include a Daikin ground-to-water heat pump, active ceilings that provide cooling during the summer months, Heroal windows with safety film, heat recovery, a central vacuum system, provision for a photovoltaic system, and more. Naturally, there are four parking spaces, two of which are covered by a concrete canopy, ensuring you can walk from your car to the entrance without getting wet, whatever the weather. The result is a timeless, modern home equipped with technology that goes beyond the boundaries of standard construction.
Zdiměřice is one of the most sought-after locations in the vicinity of the capital; here you’ll find a development of high-end detached houses and abundant greenery, whilst the capital is literally on your doorstep.
One of the area’s greatest attractions is its proximity to Průhonice Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The surrounding countryside is perfect for walks in the woods and the park, and the Prague–Vienna cycle route runs through the village. Zdiměřice thus offers a rare combination: peace and quiet and natural surroundings, together with a fast and convenient connection to the centre of Prague.
In the immediate vicinity of Malebná Street, there is a new state primary school as well as the popular private Sunny Canadian International School, along with a nursery school and a grammar school. The full range of schools and nurseries is complemented by the neighbouring district of Jesenice, which also has an elementary art school.
Connections to Prague are provided by PID bus routes (e.g. 327 and 428) to the Opatov, Háje, Kačerov and Budějovická stops. The journey to the centre of Prague takes approximately 20 minutes by car; the area is close to the Prague Ring Road (D0) and the slip road onto the D1 motorway.

0c51209b697303ab:
A south-facing plot of 4,000 m² with views of the Brdy Mountains

We are offering for sale a building plot of 4,000 m² in the cadastral area of Lážovice (parcel no. 539/29). The plot is south-facing, sunny and offers beautiful views of the Brdy ridges. Thanks to its ideal orientation, it also offers excellent conditions for the installation of a photovoltaic power plant (PV). Construction of the municipal sewerage system is currently underway, with a proposed connection for this plot, and we have a favourable hydrogeological assessment. The local plan designates this area as rural residential, permitting a maximum built-up area of 30 per cent and reserving 60 per cent of the area for gardens and green spaces.  Buildings may be a maximum of two storeys high, with gable or shaped roofs with a pitch of 33–45°. The plot is connected to a local road. The location is peaceful; Lážovice lies between the D5 and D4 motorways, within easy reach of the Brdy and Křivoklátsko Protected Landscape Areas, approximately 15 km from Beroun, and the village of Dobříš is a 15-minute drive away. cb76653bee35daa5:
New 3+kk flat to let in the Modřanský cukrovar development, with a parking space and a private wallbox

We are offering a brand-new 3+kk flat for rent in the Modřanský cukrovar development, which is being built on the banks of the Vltava River on the site of a former sugar factory in Prague-Modřany. The flat also includes a 4.8 m² cellar and an exceptionally spacious parking space (17 m²) in the underground garages, equipped with a wallbox for convenient charging of your electric car right next to your vehicle.
The 3+kk flat, with a total area of approx. 77.6 m² + 16.2 m² covered balcony (running the full length of the living room), offers a bright living room with a partial view of the River Vltava, two bedrooms, a bathroom with a toilet, a separate toilet and a storage room within the flat itself. The flat will feature a modern fitted kitchen (see the visualisation photo), a built-in wardrobe in the hallway and lighting. The windows are fitted with external blinds.
Modřanský cukrovar is one of the most modern residential developments in Prague and places an emphasis on quality of living and sustainability; energy efficiency class A, rainwater harvesting, external blinds, underfloor heating, shared roof terraces, community gardens and semi-public play areas for children between the buildings.
The Modřany area is particularly popular thanks to its combination of urban convenience and proximity to nature. Within walking distance is a cycle path along the River Vltava, ideal for sport and leisure activities, as well as the Modřanská rokle nature park. The area naturally boasts a full range of local amenities, including shops, restaurants, cafés, schools and nurseries.
A tram stop is within a short walking distance and offers a direct connection to the centre of Prague. The area also has good links to the main transport routes.
The monthly rent is 38,000 CZK, utility charges are 4,743 CZK for 2 people (an additional 500 CZK for each further person) and the refundable deposit is set at 76,000 CZK. The tenant does not pay an estate agent’s commission. The electricity supply will be transferred to the tenant.
